page.notes: The bullet "•" after "Abyffus." is a stray printed mark, reproduced as best as possible and not part of the entry. The mark over "E" in "Edificatio" and the mark over "Æ" in "Ægrè" are small printed signs; I have not reproduced them. The "a" of "Abominationes" is a woodcut initial, joined to its word. The first line of the title is partly unreadable at the right edge, and the title words are spaced as far as they can be read. Lower left signature and lower right catchword read as printed; the signature letter is doubtful. Some letters in the title lines and the word "facti" are doubtful or obscured.
